decision.rationale: Confirmed facts show a significant degradation of application-to-person SMS delivery (latency over 6 minutes, 38% undelivered) coinciding with a new AI traffic-management model rollout 20 minutes earlier. The illustrative incident-reporting clause obligates the telecom operator to report such significant degradation to the telecom regulator within 60 minutes of becoming aware. I am also requesting incident information from the regulator and investigating the network fault to determine whether the AI pipeline caused the reclassification or whether this is ordinary congestion. I do not yet know whether the AI model update caused the spike, whether patient or health data is involved, or whether the regulator has additional incident details.

citations.quote_span: a licensed telecom operator reports to the telecom regulator any network incident that significantly degrades a public telecommunications service, within 60 minutes of becoming aware of it.
citations.relevance: Supports reporting the significant SMS delivery degradation to the telecom regulator within 60 minutes.

citations.quote_span: the telecom regulator may request from a licensed operator information about a network incident affecting a public telecommunications service.
citations.relevance: Supports requesting information from the regulator about the incident.
